faqs.question: How do I redeem my flat ₹500 OFF coupon?
faqs.answer: Register on the website, download the generated coupon card (PNG), and present it at the billing counter of the exhibition at Radisson Hotel Bhopal during checkout.

faqs.question: Is the coupon valid on all premium brands?
faqs.answer: Yes, the coupon is valid on a minimum bill purchase of ₹3,000 across all participating premium and luxury brands.

faqs.question: What are the timings and entry fee for the event?
faqs.answer: Entry is completely free! The event is open from June 25th to 28th, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM and closing at 9:00 PM.
